desc.cn: 首都節奏：預約系統、安檢長隊與「外國面孔」注視同時在線。故宮與長城是必修，環球影城會燒乾錢包；國博免費但要搶票。北京教你第一課——在中國，時間常常比錢更貴。
desc.en: Capital tempo: reservation systems, security lines, and constant stares at a foreign face. Palace and Wall are required reading; Universal melts wallets; the National Museum is free if you can book. Beijing’s first lesson: time often costs more than money.

text.cn: 故宮門票預約失敗！你不得不花高價向黃牛買票，資金 -200，精神值 -10。
text.en: Failed to reserve Forbidden City ticket! You had to buy from a scalper. Money -200, Sanity -10.

desc.cn: 魔都規則：幾乎一切都要掃碼。外灘夜景浪漫，南京路和小程序點單現實；迪士尼是時間黑洞，武康路是喘息口。上海不缺國際化表象——缺的是「沒有微信也能活」的幻覺。
desc.en: Shanghai rules: almost everything wants a QR code. The Bund is romance; Nanjing Road and mini-programs are reality. Disney is a time sink, Wukang a breather. The city looks international — until you try living without WeChat.

text.cn: 點單時強制要求綁定微信小程序並授權個人資訊，你花了 15 分鐘才關掉廣告彈窗，精神值 -5，時間 -0.5小時。
text.en: Forced to use WeChat mini-program to order. Spent 15 mins closing ads. Sanity -5, Time -0.5h.

desc.cn: 慢城攻擊性治愈：熊貓、蓋碗茶、掏耳朵與「微辣」火鍋並行。春熙路打卡與人民公園相親角同樣熱鬧。成都讓你學會一件事——把一天交給竹椅，比把一天交給導航更像勝利。
desc.en: Aggressive chill: pandas, covered-bowl tea, ear cleaning, and “mild” hotpot that isn’t. Chunxi check-ins and People’s Park matchmaking are equally loud. Chengdu teaches you that surrendering a day to a bamboo chair can beat winning at navigation.

text.cn: 低估了四川「微辣」的威力，你在馬桶上度過了大半天。精神值 -20，時間 -4小時。
text.en: Underestimated Sichuan's 'mild spicy'. Spent half the day in the restroom. Sanity -20, Time -4h.

desc.cn: 3D 立體迷宮：洪崖洞燈火、李子壩穿樓、索道過江。導航說「直行」時你可能在 8 樓。重慶用台階重寫 GPS，用夜景補償膝蓋；解放碑商場與磁器口古鎮是兩種完全不同的擁擠。
desc.en: A 3D maze: Hongyadong lights, Liziba’s train-through-building, cableways over the Yangtze. “Go straight” may exit on floor 8. Chongqing rewrites GPS with stairs and pays you back in night views; Jiefangbei malls and Ciqikou lanes are two different kinds of crowd.

text.cn: 導航帶你走進了某棟大樓的 8 樓，出去發現居然又是馬路。你迷路了 2 小時，精神值 -15，時間 -2小時。
text.en: GPS led you to the 8th floor, only to find it connects to another street. Lost for 2h. Sanity -15, Time -2h.

desc.cn: 硬件與閘機之城：華強北像未來零件市場，地鐵刷臉常把外國面孔拒之門外。深圳灣適合騎行回血，歡樂谷與世界之窗消耗電量與耐心。這裡創業口號很多——真正的生存技能是乘車碼。
desc.en: Hardware and gates: Huaqiangbei feels like a futures market for parts; face gates often reject foreign faces. Shenzhen Bay restores you by bike; Happy Valley and Window of the World spend battery and patience. Startup slogans are everywhere — the real skill is the transit QR.

text.cn: 地鐵站出站體驗無人刷臉閘機失敗，被迫排長隊人工核驗。精神值 -5，時間 -0.5小時。
text.en: Failed to use facial recognition gate at subway. Forced to wait in a long manual line. Sanity -5, Time -0.5h.

desc.cn: 離境前的緩衝區：維港風、太平山燈、旺角密度與蘭桂坊噪音。雙幣、八達通與突然恢復的外網會讓你恍惚。香港既是玩樂站，也是結局閘口——走到「離境口岸」才算真正通關。
desc.en: A buffer before exit: harbour wind, Peak lights, Mong Kok density, LKF noise. Dual currency, Octopus, and suddenly working foreign internet feel surreal. Hong Kong is both playground and ending gate — you only truly finish at Exit Border.

text.cn: 在茶餐廳因為沒有港幣現金被加收了高額匯率差，資金 -50，精神值 -10。
text.en: Charged extra exchange fee at a cafe because you had no HKD cash. Money -50, Sanity -10.

desc.cn: 十三朝古都的現代陷阱：兵馬俑周邊黃牛話術很熟練，回民街香氣與英語小費並存，城牆騎行能短暫逃離地麵噪音。大唐不夜城把盛唐做成燈會；華山用腿抖重新定義「打卡」。
desc.en: An ancient capital with modern traps: polished scalper scripts near the Terracotta Army, Muslim Quarter aromas beside English-tip hustles, wall biking as escape from street noise. Datang Night City turns Tang into neon; Mount Hua redefines check-ins as leg terror.

text.cn: 成功識破路邊山寨兵馬俑一日遊導遊的騙局！精神值 +10，省下了冤枉錢。
text.en: Successfully spotted a fake Terracotta Army tour guide! Sanity +10, saved money.

desc.cn: 阿凡達石峰現場：森林公園像迷宮行政區，玻璃棧道專治腿軟，百龍天梯專治排隊。外網上傳慢到像懲罰。張家界的特色不是「看山」，而是「在巨大裡找路，還要保持 Sanity」。
desc.en: Avatar pillars IRL: the forest park feels like a prefecture-sized maze, glass walks punish knees, Bailong Elevator punishes queues. Foreign uploads crawl like a penalty. The point isn’t “see mountains” — it’s navigating hugeness without melting your sanity.

text.cn: 站在高空玻璃棧道上雙腿發軟，進退兩難。精神值 -25，時間 -1.5小時。
text.en: Legs shaking on the glass bridge, paralyzed with fear. Sanity -25, Time -1.5h.

desc.cn: 山水甲天下，消費也甲天下：灕江竹筏、象鼻山角度戰、兩江四湖夜燈。陽朔西街把酒吧與合照經濟疊加；十里畫廊騎行最接近「詩意」，溶洞則把冷與滑一道送來。
desc.en: Karst postcard, commerce included: Li River rafts, Elephant Hill angle wars, Two Rivers night lights. Yangshuo stacks bars with photo economies; the Ten-Mile Gallery bike ride is the closest thing to poetry; caves deliver cold and slick footing as a set.

text.cn: 在灕江竹筏被強推拍照服務，拒絕後遭遇竹筏師傅「龜速前行」報復。精神值 -15，時間 -1小時。
text.en: Refused photo service on bamboo raft. Driver retaliated by going extremely slow. Sanity -15, Time -1h.

desc.cn: 信仰與海拔同時在線：布達拉預約嚴格，八廓轉經要你放慢，納木錯與珠峰用高反改寫行程。免簽/144 常被拒之門外。西藏不是打卡清單——是氧氣、耐心與敬畏的壓力測試。
desc.en: Faith and altitude at once: strict Potala booking, Barkhor circuits that force you slow, Namtso and Everest rewriting plans via thin air. Visa-free/144 often cannot enter. Tibet isn’t a checklist — it’s a stress test of oxygen, patience, and respect.

text.cn: 高原反應突襲！你不得不花錢買高壓氧氣瓶並在旅館躺了一整天。資金 -150，精神值 -20，時間 -24小時。
text.en: Altitude sickness struck! Had to buy oxygen cylinders and rest in hotel. Money -150, Sanity -20, Time -24h.

desc.cn: 遼闊本身就是機制：大巴扎串香與語言梗，天池清靜，喀納斯/賽里木/那拉提都在「遠」裡。獨庫公路讓你明白「附近」的定義被重寫；安檢與長途會同時消耗 Sanity 與時間。
desc.en: Distance is the mechanic: bazaar skewers and language false friends, quiet Tianchi, Kanas/Sayram/Nalati all living inside “far”. Duku Highway redefines “nearby”; security and long hauls spend sanity and hours together.

text.cn: 安全檢查排隊長達 2 小時，無人機開機直接被扣押警告。精神值 -20，時間 -2小時。
text.en: Waited 2 hours for security check. Drone confiscated. Sanity -20, Time -2h.

desc.cn: 六朝煙水氣：中山陵臺階、夫子廟燈火、秦淮河畫舫。總統府與南博偏靜，雞鳴寺與牛首山偏視覺衝擊。南京用「鴨」與近代史同時招待你——人潮是標配，安靜要自己搶。
desc.en: Southern-capital mist: mausoleum stairs, Confucius Temple lanterns, Qinhuai boats. Presidential Palace and the museum lean quiet; Jiming and Niushou lean spectacle. Nanjing serves duck and modern history together — crowds are default, quiet is earned.

text.cn: 在排隊買鴨血粉絲湯時被插隊，精神值 -10。但分量很足，飽腹感 +15（精神值微幅恢復 +5）。
text.en: Someone cut in front of you while queuing for duck soup. Sanity -5.

desc.cn: 人間天堂的精緻壓力：西湖要慢，靈隱要早，龍井要走，河坊街要小心菜單陷阱。西溪與錢江新城分別提供自然與天際線回血。杭州很美——美到你會為「詩意」支付時間稅。
desc.en: Paradise with polish-tax: West Lake wants slow, Lingyin wants early, Longjing wants walking, Hefang wants menu caution. Xixi and Qianjiang restore via nature and skyline. Hangzhou is beautiful enough to charge a time tax for poetry.

text.cn: 午餐嘗試了西湖醋魚，味道一言難盡。花費了高昂餐費，胃部與心靈同時受到重創。資金 -120，精神值 -25。
text.en: Tried West Lake Vinegar Fish. Terrible taste, expensive price. Money -120, Sanity -25.

desc.cn: 熱帶度假的現實面：亞龍灣海風治愈，蜈支洲看船班運氣，免税城考验支付，海鲜市场考验报价与过敏。南山与天涯是打卡碑石；潜水店要扫码填表。三亚教你：阳光不等于低压力。
desc.en: Tropical escape, unfiltered: Yalong wind heals, Wuzhizhou depends on ferry luck, duty-free tests payment, seafood markets test quotes and allergies. Nanshan and Tianya are stone check-ins; dive shops want QR forms. Sanya’s lesson: sunshine ≠ low stress.

text.cn: 在海鮮大排檔遭遇「天價椰子雞與海鮮秤重刺客」，錢包大出血！資金 -450，精神值 -20。
text.en: Encountered seafood rip-off. Huge loss of money. Money -450, Sanity -20.
